title: BALD-SAM: Disagreement-based Active Prompting in Interactive Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2603.10828v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) has revolutionized interactive segmentation through spatial prompting. While existing work primarily focuses on automating prompts in various settings, real-world annotation workflows involve iterative refinement where annotators observe model outputs and strategically place prompts to resolve ambiguities. Current pipelines typically rely on the annotator's visual assessment of the predicted mask quality. We postulate that a principled approach for automated interactive prompting is to use a model-derived criterion to identify the most informative region for the next prompt. In this work, we establish active prompting: a spatial active learning approach where locations within images constitute an unlabeled pool and prompts serve as queries to prioritize information-rich regions, increasing the utility of each interaction. translated_title: BALD-SAM：交互式分割中基于分歧的主动提示方法
translated_abstract: 分割一切模型（SAM）通过空间提示彻底改变了交互式分割领域。尽管现有工作主要聚焦于在各种场景下实现提示的自动化，但真实世界的标注工作流涉及迭代式细化过程，标注者需要观察模型输出并策略性地放置提示以消除歧义。当前的流程通常依赖于标注者对预测掩码质量的主观视觉评估。我们提出，自动化交互式提示的一种有原则的方法是使用由模型导出的准则来识别下一次提示最具信息量的区域。在本工作中，我们建立了“主动提示”这一概念：一种空间主动学习方法，其中图像内的各个位置构成未标记样本池，提示则作为查询用于优先选择信息丰富的区域，从而提升每次交互的效用。我们进一步提出了BALD-SAM：一个采用贝叶斯主动学习分歧方法的原则性框架…
tldr: 本文提出“主动提示”新范式，将图像内位置视为未标记样本池、提示作为查询，并基于BALD-SAM框架利用贝叶斯分歧准则自动选择下一次提示的最优空间位置，从而最大化SAM交互式分割中每次人机交互的信息效用。
en_tdlr: BALD-SAM introduces "active prompting," a spatial active learning framework that treats image locations as an unlabeled pool and prompts as queries, using disagreement-based Bayesian active learning to automatically select the most informative region for the next prompt, thereby maximizing the utility of each interaction in SAM-based interactive segmentation.
